card.name: Partway into a word or name
card.fires_on: Responds on a short piece at the start of a longer word or name, or on a small linking word just before a capitalized name or term. Examples are the 'can' in canola, 'C' before LEVELAND or YP3A, and 'of' before a drug or place name.

modes.label: Start of a split word
modes.description: The first piece of a word or all-caps name that continues in the next piece.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A small word like of, and or a comma right before a drug, place or organization name.
